dataset.description: Household survey of Syrian refugees in four countries of asylum, covering displacement history, housing/land/property at origin, return intentions, employment, social cohesion, economic status and protection risks. One row per household per round, reported by a single adult respondent whose position on the roster is recorded in s2_1_hh_relationship_lbl. Countries of asylum: Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Lebanon (46 governorates); areas of origin: 15 Syrian governorates. Fieldwork May-June 2025 over 67 distinct interview dates, with both wave labels falling inside the same two-month window. Three mutually exclusive conditional branches hang off the twelve-month return-intention item (s3_11): a return branch (s7a), a do-not-return branch (s7b) and an undecided branch (s7c). Note that no questionnaire was delivered with this file: every question string below is a gloss reconstructed from the variable name and the observed response labels, and is not verbatim instrument wording.
